unit_split: articles over 6,000 characters are split into parts at line boundaries (protocol corpus.unit)
query_note: the item's question and options exactly as the frozen B prompt carries them, without its instruction head and answer tail; no gold, label or arm outcome
tokens: maximal runs of Unicode word characters (Vietnamese syllables and numbers)

bm25.query_terms: each distinct query token counts once

truncation: none; units are at most about 6,000 characters
fixed_on: 2026-10-29, before any retrieval query: the bm25-article-v0 settings of corpus v0, untuned, with top_k 2 (the evidence budget of arm O)
